entities.name: Query enoyl reductase
observations: 397 aa bacterial protein; estimated molecular mass 43.44 kDa and theoretical pI 5.43.
Exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt Q1H0P3 from Methylobacillus flagellatus.
Pfam domains: Eno-Rase_NADH_b PF12242 at residues 2-78, Enoyl_reductase PF12241 at 81-316, and Eno-Rase_FAD_bd PF07055 at 322-385.
Strongest functional assignment is NADH-dependent enoyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] reductase of bacterial FAS II; exact substrate scope should not be expanded beyond the homolog evidence.

entities.name: Q1H0P3
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Methylobacillus flagellatus annotated as enoyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] reductase [NADH].
EC 1.3.1.9; Rhea RHEA:10240; annotated as a monomer.
Reference active-site proton donor is position 234; position 74 contributes to NADH versus NADPH discrimination.

entities.name: FAS II fatty acid biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme performs the terminal reduction step of each bacterial fatty-acid elongation cycle, reducing an enoyl moiety linked to ACP using NADH.
Associated GO process is fatty acid biosynthetic process (GO:0006633).
